patch_description: Key parameters identified in the current best (score 0.65): pure-RTS slope lead with gate center `0.25·q_scale`, gate temperature `0.15·q_scale`, and lead amplitude `0.5·sg_half·0.25`. Prior evidence (Gen 77) indicates a 0.3 blend with a smoothed-level gradient slope improves responsiveness (lower lag_error, higher responsiveness_score) without materially hurting slope_changes or false_reversals, but that round confounded the blend with other changes. This variant keeps every gate/lead constant verbatim and changes a single variable: the Stage-3 slope channel now uses `slope = 0.7·slope_rts + 0.3·slope_grad`, where `slope_grad` is the robust central-difference gradient of the SG-smoothed level. This fuses the smoother's optimally-denoised slope (smoothness, few false reversals) with the zero-phase SG level's local gradient (responsiveness at genuine turning points), isolating the blend effect for a clean single-variable score delta.
